package unformatted

// gofmt would rewrite both shapes below, the parentheses around a loop's condition away and a loop of empty
// clauses around a condition to the condition alone, and the guard holds every .go file of the tree to gofmt, so this
// one is kept as text and written out as Go where the test loads it. A parenthesized condition is no identifier, so
// IsBoolConst refuses it and the original leaves the loop alone, and empty clauses parse as no initializer and no post
// statement, so the original reports the loop, its header running from the keyword to the end of the condition.

func leftAloneParenthesized() {
	for (true) {
	}
}

func leftAloneDoublyParenthesized() {
	for ((true)) {
	}
}

func reportedEmptyClauses() {
	for ; true; {
	}
}

func leftAloneParenthesizedEmptyClauses() {
	for ; (true); {
	}
}
